title: Stable identity
requirement: The system shall assign permanent IDs to procedures, revisions and steps, independent of displayed numbering.
acceptance: Insert a step and verify historical signatures and result links still reference the original steps.

title: Immutable release
requirement: The system shall freeze a released revision and its dependent content; edits shall create a new revision.
acceptance: Modify a draft and verify an existing released package and its digest remain unchanged.

title: Structured steps
requirement: The system shall support instructions, typed inputs, measurements, scripts, hold points, witnesses, attachments and subprocedures.
acceptance: Execute a representative procedure containing every supported step type with required inputs enforced.

title: Execution guards
requirement: The system shall enforce prerequisites, allowed branches, loops and mandatory hold points in the runtime.
acceptance: Attempt a direct API bypass of a hold point and confirm rejection and an audit event.

title: Release validation
requirement: The system shall reject missing references, invalid units, unresolved required roles and unsupported package dependencies.
acceptance: Run invalid-package fixtures and verify release is blocked with actionable diagnostics.

title: Configuration applicability
requirement: The system shall restrict procedure use by article identity, configuration and approved applicability rules.
acceptance: Start against a mismatched hardware revision and confirm an explicit blocking result.

title: Import and export
requirement: The system shall import structured procedures as drafts and export full content with stable identities and revision history.
acceptance: Round-trip a procedure and identify any unsupported imported content before release.

title: Requirement mapping
requirement: The system shall link steps and analyses to versioned verification requirements and methods.
acceptance: Change a requirement revision and verify affected released procedures and evidence are flagged for review.

title: Reusable content provenance
requirement: The system shall record the source revision and expansion of every template, snippet and included procedure in each released package.
acceptance: Revise a reused snippet; verify an existing run is unchanged and affected future drafts can be identified.
basis: Derived refinement: reuse requires dependency provenance, not a mutable reference.

title: Import reconciliation
requirement: The system shall produce a source-to-draft mapping and unresolved-conversion report for imported procedures, requiring author disposition before release.
acceptance: Import a document with merged tables, warnings, units and ambiguous numbering; verify no missing item is silently accepted.
basis: Derived refinement: a fast import is useful only if meaning survives conversion.

title: Default value provenance
requirement: The system shall distinguish default, copied, manually observed and instrument-acquired values and prohibit an unconfirmed default from satisfying a required observation.
acceptance: Start a run with an in-limit default; verify it cannot produce a measured pass or witness signature before an authorized observation.
basis: TestForge policy derived from the risk of prefilled observations.

title: Explainable branch decisions
requirement: The system shall persist each branch decision with its expression revision, input values and selected path, treating missing or invalid operands as unresolved.
acceptance: Exercise section and variable branches with false, missing and stale operands; reproduce each decision from exported evidence.
basis: Derived refinement: branching must remain reconstructable after inputs change.

title: Iteration identity
requirement: The system shall identify each planned batch iteration separately from a retest attempt and bind its inputs, signatures and dependencies to that iteration.
acceptance: Run three planned cycles and repeat the second after failure; verify four attempts remain with three planned cycle identities.
basis: Derived refinement of batch execution; planned repetition is not a replacement for failed evidence.

title: Test condition matrix
requirement: The system shall version the planned combinations of test points, configurations and environmental conditions and report coverage against that matrix.
acceptance: Plan two configurations at three temperatures; execute five combinations and verify the sixth remains uncovered despite all five passing.
basis: Derived test-management requirement; detailed matrix semantics are TestForge design.

title: Versioned execution policy
requirement: The system shall bind each run to a released execution-policy revision that defines shared setup, article admission, test invocation, result handling and completion gates separately from test-specific steps.
acceptance: Run two procedures under one policy; revise the policy and verify earlier run packages retain the original policy and its gates.
basis: Derived architectural requirement: common station behavior is part of the approved execution definition.

title: Preflight rule analysis
requirement: The system shall run a versioned set of structural and contract checks before release and retain machine-readable findings with dispositions of any waivers.
acceptance: Seed missing modules, incompatible parameter types, an undeclared resource and an unresolved cleanup path; verify release blocks and findings identify stable step IDs.
basis: Derived refinement: validation needs inspectable rule provenance and actionable diagnostics; it is not proof of physical safety.

title: Run identity
requirement: The system shall assign unique run and attempt IDs with article, station, package and personnel context.
acceptance: Start two offline runs and verify their imported records cannot collide.

title: Durable transitions
requirement: The system shall commit an accepted transition and its event before returning success to the browser.
acceptance: Terminate immediately after acknowledgment and recover the same accepted state.

title: Explicit outcomes
requirement: The system shall distinguish pass, fail, inconclusive, error, invalid, aborted, skipped and not evaluated outcomes.
acceptance: Inject each outcome and verify it cannot become pass through missing data or an exception.

title: Hold and resume
requirement: The system shall apply declared hold and browser-disconnect policies, and recheck prerequisites before resumption.
acceptance: Close the browser during acquisition, then change an instrument during a hold; verify the declared response and blocked resume.

title: Unknown outcome
requirement: The system shall enter recovery required after an interrupted operation whose hardware effect cannot be established.
acceptance: Crash after command transmission but before result persistence; verify no automatic retransmission.

title: Retry classification
requirement: The system shall require each operation to declare read-only, idempotent or nonrepeatable behavior with an approved retry policy.
acceptance: Verify retries are bounded and a nonrepeatable operation cannot use generic automatic retries.

title: Resource ownership
requirement: The system shall permit one controlling authority per run and exclusive resource set, including during disconnection.
acceptance: Attempt a second controller and confirm hardware access is denied until a valid handoff.

title: Handover record
requirement: The system shall record shift handover, active configuration, held operations and transfer of operator responsibility.
acceptance: Resume after a personnel change and verify the new operator acknowledges outstanding conditions.

title: Scoped hold constraints
requirement: The system shall maintain independent run, section and step holds with reason, owner and explicit release predicates, preserving child holds when a parent clears.
acceptance: Set an issue hold and a separate child QA hold; resolve the issue and verify the child stays held and its owner is displayed.
basis: Derived refinement: a dependency becoming satisfied does not imply all holds are released.

title: Command resume authorization
requirement: The system shall require an authorized local resume decision and renewed hardware readiness checks before a cleared workflow constraint can permit a hardware command.
acceptance: Clear a remote issue while a local step is paused; verify no command is sent until the local gate is completed.
basis: TestForge policy intentionally separates automatic administrative progress from hardware resumption.

title: Duration semantics
requirement: The system shall define elapsed, active and hold time separately and record the clock and pause/reset policy used by duration-dependent acceptance rules.
acceptance: Pause a dwell, move wall time backward and restart the station; verify the configured rule cannot count unobserved time as valid dwell.
basis: Derived refinement; measured task duration alone does not prove a valid physical soak.

title: Lifecycle extension contract
requirement: The system shall declare the order, scope, failure handling and privileges of lifecycle hooks and include their resolved implementations in the run package.
acceptance: Configure station and procedure hooks for the same event; verify deterministic order, no hidden duplicate action and explicit handling of a failed hook.
basis: Derived refinement: extension hooks must not silently change execution or suppress mandatory gates.

title: Cleanup evidence
requirement: The system shall record required cleanup obligations as resources are acquired, their attempted actions and outcomes, and unresolved obligations after abnormal termination.
acceptance: Fail midway through setup and again during cleanup; verify only applicable obligations are attempted and an unconfirmed safe state remains unresolved.
basis: Derived requirement: termination policy does not guarantee successful physical safing or cleanup after loss of power.

title: Parallel cohort control
requirement: The system shall give each concurrent article its own execution identity and define barrier membership, timeout, withdrawal and shared-action attribution for coordinated cohorts.
acceptance: Run three articles through a shared chamber action; remove one at a barrier and verify bounded disposition for all three without assigning its evidence to the survivors.
basis: Derived distinction between coordinated multi-article execution and repeated steps within one run.

title: Individual identity
requirement: The system shall authenticate individual operators, witnesses and approvers without shared sign-off accounts.
acceptance: Verify two people using one workstation retain distinct authenticated signature records.

title: Independent witness
requirement: The system shall enforce separate operator and QA identities when a step requires independence.
acceptance: Give one account both roles and confirm it still cannot satisfy both signatures.

title: Approval policies
requirement: The system shall support named approvers, role slots, all-of and explicitly configured quorum rules with ordering.
acceptance: Exercise three required approvers, rejection and optional observers without premature approval.

title: Signature meaning
requirement: The system shall bind each signature to identity, role, meaning, timestamp, policy and exact subject/evidence digest.
acceptance: Alter the signed content and verify the old signature cannot approve the new revision.

title: Reauthentication
requirement: The system shall require a configured confirmation and reauthentication policy for consequential signatures.
acceptance: Expire a signing session and verify a normal UI click cannot silently sign.

title: Offline authority
requirement: The system shall validate locally provisioned, bounded identity and role grants for disconnected actions.
acceptance: Cold-start offline and verify permitted signing works while an expired or out-of-scope grant fails.

title: Observers and comments
requirement: The system shall separate viewing, commenting, executing, witnessing and approving permissions.
acceptance: Verify a read-only collaborator neither mutates the run nor becomes a required approver.

title: Delegation and revocation
requirement: The system shall record authorized delegation and reconcile newly discovered revocations without erasing prior signatures.
acceptance: Revoke an offline user centrally and verify reconnect creates an attributable review issue.

title: Qualification at action time
requirement: The system shall check required skill and certification validity for the specific role and action at execution and signoff time, retaining the evaluated qualification snapshot.
acceptance: Expire QA qualification after run start; verify a new QA signoff is blocked locally and online without erasing earlier signatures.
basis: Derived refinement: an assigned role can be temporarily unusable; offline validity must be explicit.

title: Granular evidence signatures
requirement: The system shall allow signatures on identified table rows and content blocks with defined required fields and freeze their signed evidence scope.
acceptance: Sign one row, reorder rows and edit a second row; verify the original signature still identifies the first row and rejects an unsigned change to its evidence.
basis: Derived refinement of row signatures and required versus optional content.

title: Signature withdrawal
requirement: The system shall record withdrawal of a signature as a new attributed event with reason, preserving the original signature and reevaluating dependent approvals.
acceptance: Withdraw a row signature after QA review; verify the original remains inspectable, closure is blocked and no hardware operation is repeated.
basis: Derived distinction between correcting an approval and physically repeating a test.

title: Review round integrity
requirement: The system shall bind staged approvals and comment dispositions to a review round and content revision, with required redisposition after a consequential change.
acceptance: Approve engineering review, change an acceptance limit during QA review and verify the obsolete approval cannot authorize release.
basis: Derived refinement: staged review must not retain misleading approval applicability.

title: Proposed redlines
requirement: The system shall record redlines as explicit proposals with original content, proposed content, reason and affected scope.
acceptance: Show the exact before/after change and proposer for an inserted or altered step.

title: Approval before use
requirement: The system shall block affected execution until the required redline approvals are complete.
acceptance: Propose a changed limit while running and verify the original approved limit remains operative.

title: Run and master scope
requirement: The system shall distinguish run-only changes from proposed changes to the master procedure.
acceptance: Approve a run insertion and verify other runs and the released master do not change.

title: Evidence preservation
requirement: The system shall retain original observations and append corrections with reason, author and time.
acceptance: Correct a signed numeric result and verify both values and affected approvals remain traceable.

title: Skip and defer
requirement: The system shall require reason, authority and disposition for skipped, deferred or not-applicable required steps.
acceptance: Attempt closure with an unauthorized skip and confirm it is blocked.

title: Retest linkage
requirement: The system shall create a new attempt for every retest and retain prior failed and invalid attempts.
acceptance: Pass a retest and verify the failed attempt remains in reports and requirement disposition.

title: Impact invalidation
requirement: The system shall mark affected downstream evidence and approvals for reevaluation after consequential changes.
acceptance: Change a calibration correction or limit and verify dependent analysis approval becomes stale.

title: Nonconformance
requirement: The system shall link deviations and nonconformances to article, run, affected steps and authorized dispositions.
acceptance: Accept a documented waiver and verify the measured failure is preserved rather than relabeled pass.

title: Cross-run change adoption
requirement: The system shall present a shared redline as a separately evaluated change for each receiving run, with applicability, impact assessment and adoption approval before use.
acceptance: Offer one change to runs with pending, executing and signed affected steps; verify each obtains an explicit disposition and no signed history is rewritten.
basis: TestForge policy; propagation transports a proposal, not authority to overwrite a running baseline.

title: Historical revision restoration
requirement: The system shall restore earlier procedure content only into a new draft with ancestry and normal release review.
acceptance: Restore an older revision; verify original releases and run links are unchanged and the restored draft cannot execute as a released revision.
basis: Derived refinement of version rollback semantics.

title: Script provenance
requirement: The system shall execute only approved script packages with pinned dependencies and recorded hashes in flight mode.
acceptance: Change one script byte or dependency and confirm execution is refused.

title: Process isolation
requirement: The system shall run scripts in supervised worker processes with bounded resources and separate credentials.
acceptance: Hang or crash a worker and verify the UI, journal and supervision remain available.

title: Driver abstraction
requirement: The system shall provide versioned adapters for VISA, serial, USB and required vendor APIs with simulated equivalents.
acceptance: Run the same measurement contract against a simulator and representative approved equipment.

title: Instrument identity
requirement: The system shall verify actual device identity and configured resource mapping before permitting commands.
acceptance: Swap two USB devices or change an address and verify the wrong instrument is blocked.

title: Operation journal
requirement: The system shall persist command intent, operation ID and observed outcome without claiming atomic hardware execution.
acceptance: Interrupt at each dispatch boundary and verify an honest completed or unknown classification.

title: Bounded cancellation
requirement: The system shall specify command timeouts, cancellation escalation and equipment-specific recovery actions.
acceptance: Block a driver call and demonstrate the approved timeout and independent recovery behavior.

title: Safety boundary
requirement: The system shall respect independent interlocks and enforce approved command envelopes and operating modes.
acceptance: Request an out-of-envelope command and verify rejection; prove a failed process cannot defeat the hardware interlock.

title: Data protocol
requirement: The system shall ingest typed worker measurements and artifacts through a validated protocol separate from diagnostic logs.
acceptance: Send malformed units, duplicate samples and a truncated artifact; verify explicit rejection or incomplete status.

title: Command failure propagation
requirement: The system shall map command rejection, execution failure, timeout and unknown outcome into explicit step dispositions and prevent automatic success or progression through a required failed command.
acceptance: Inject all four outcomes into a multi-command step; verify evidence distinguishes them and no later hazardous command runs implicitly.
basis: Derived refinement: a single Boolean command result loses essential recovery information.

title: Telemetry acceptance window
requirement: The system shall evaluate telemetry-based acceptance using a versioned rule defining units, sample validity, freshness and required observation window.
acceptance: Replay a previously passing stale sample, then introduce a data gap during a required dwell; verify neither yields a valid pass.
basis: TestForge-derived integrity rule; vendor integration and duration features motivate it, not establish equivalent behavior.

title: Worker session lifecycle
requirement: The system shall declare worker session scope and reset rules, reject stale handles after restart and prohibit undeclared cross-run interpreter state.
acceptance: Set module state in run A, execute run B, then restart the worker; verify isolation/reset policy and rejection of old instrument or object handles.
basis: Derived refinement: separate processes alone do not define session lifetime or eliminate shared mutable state.

title: Module call contract
requirement: The system shall validate versioned module input/output schemas and persist the resolved arguments, required outputs and conversion failures for each call.
acceptance: Exercise large integers, nonfinite readings, empty arrays, missing required returns and a changed function signature; verify explicit outcomes without silent truncation or missing required evidence.
basis: Derived interoperability requirement; a successful language call is not proof that required evidence was captured.

title: Shared instrument scheduling
requirement: The system shall schedule declared instrument resource sets with bounded waits and a documented deadlock policy while retaining ownership until physical outcomes are resolved.
acceptance: Request two instruments in opposite orders from competing runs and crash one holder; verify no indefinite wait or premature reassignment of an uncertain resource.
basis: Derived refinement: an in-process mutex is insufficient for station recovery and conflicting resource sets.

title: Asset chain
requirement: The system shall record instrument, channel, probe, cable, fixture and transducer identities needed for measurement traceability.
acceptance: Reconstruct the complete measurement chain from the saved run without live asset-system access.

title: Calibration snapshot
requirement: The system shall retain certificate revision, validity interval, correction data, uncertainty and source retrieval metadata.
acceptance: Disconnect the calibration database and reproduce the context from the prepared package.

title: Validity checks
requirement: The system shall check calibration at preparation and required use points, including expiry during a long test.
acceptance: Cross an expiry boundary and verify the approved hold or disposition policy is enforced.

title: Reference freshness
requirement: The system shall apply configured freshness and expiry policies to each cached external reference.
acceptance: Use a stale required reference offline and verify the action is blocked or explicitly authorized.

title: Controlled exceptions
requirement: The system shall require scoped approval for calibration or reference exceptions and record affected measurements.
acceptance: Verify an exception for one instrument and run does not authorize another.

title: Recall impact
requirement: The system shall identify past measurements and analyses affected by a later calibration recall or out-of-tolerance finding.
acceptance: Recall a certificate and generate the exact affected evidence set with review tasks.

title: Measurement quality
requirement: The system shall retain range, resolution, uncertainty model and approved guard-band decision rules when applicable.
acceptance: Evaluate values near a limit and verify the approved rule and its revision are reported.

title: External adapters
requirement: The system shall provide read adapters with provenance, timeouts, schema validation and independently testable mappings.
acceptance: Change an upstream schema and verify failure is explicit without modifying prior snapshots.

title: Configuration changes during testing
requirement: The system shall record article component changes with before/after configuration, serial or lot identity, effective run position and approval, reevaluating affected verification coverage.
acceptance: Replace a component between two measurements; verify each measurement resolves to the correct configuration and earlier results are not silently assigned to the replacement.
basis: Derived refinement of in-run assembly updates and genealogy.

title: Measurement representation
requirement: The system shall preserve raw values, units, precision, validity flags and evaluated limits without silent conversion.
acceptance: Round-trip large integers, decimals, timestamps and invalid readings without loss or false pass.

title: Raw and derived data
requirement: The system shall retain raw acquisitions separately from reductions, corrections and analysis outputs.
acceptance: Recompute a derived value from retained raw evidence and identify the exact algorithm revision.

title: Large artifacts
requirement: The system shall stream waveforms, images and binary files to bounded local storage with size and digest manifests.
acceptance: Acquire a 10 GB artifact without loading it entirely into memory and detect a truncated final chunk.

title: Timing evidence
requirement: The system shall record source time, receipt time, clock source, synchronization quality and sequence order.
acceptance: Move the wall clock backward and verify event order remains reconstructable and uncertainty is visible.

title: Evidence integrity
requirement: The system shall verify content digests and signed checkpoints when storing, synchronizing and exporting evidence.
acceptance: Alter or remove a retained event or artifact and verify the integrity check detects it.

title: Storage exhaustion
requirement: The system shall monitor capacity and apply a validated reserve policy before new operations can exhaust evidence storage.
acceptance: Fill the disk during acquisition and verify explicit incomplete evidence and the approved safe response.

title: Portable record
requirement: The system shall export human-readable reports and machine-readable events, schemas, manifests and raw artifacts.
acceptance: Open an export on an isolated clean system and verify its completeness without a running server.

title: Retention and restoration
requirement: The system shall retain protected records and verify coordinated backup and restore of journals and artifact files.
acceptance: Restore a backup and compare all committed evidence and manifest hashes with the source.

title: Context-aware comparison
requirement: The system shall show procedure revision, article configuration, calibration and analysis context when comparing results or attachments across runs.
acceptance: Compare visually similar records with different limit revisions and configurations; verify incompatibilities are visible before a comparison can support approval.
basis: Derived refinement: visual similarity is not proof of interchangeable evidence.

title: Independent result sink state
requirement: The system shall track required and optional result sinks separately, retaining local evidence and marking delivery failures without rewriting the measured outcome.
acceptance: Pass the measurement while the central database and report generator fail; verify the measured pass survives, delivery faults remain visible and closure is blocked where required.
basis: Derived refinement: reporting failure, test failure and final acceptance are separate states.

title: Deferred processing provenance
requirement: The system shall version deferred result-processing jobs with input digests, processor/configuration revisions, attempt history and idempotent output identity.
acceptance: Reprocess the same record twice and then with a revised report template; verify no duplicate logical ingest and distinguish both report versions without changing raw evidence.
basis: Derived refinement: tracking processed files alone does not establish replay-safe, reproducible downstream records.

title: Local web application
requirement: The system shall serve all required UI assets and APIs locally without runtime Internet dependencies.
acceptance: Start the browser and station after a reboot with every external network disconnected.

title: Prepared package
requirement: The system shall verify package completeness, signatures, dependencies, reference validity and storage before offline readiness.
acceptance: Remove each required package element in turn and verify readiness fails.

title: Local source of record
requirement: The system shall record every acknowledged input, signature, transition and result locally before replication.
acceptance: Disable the central database throughout a run and recover every acknowledged record locally.

title: Crash durability
requirement: The system shall recover committed events and identify incomplete operations after process or power interruption.
acceptance: Inject interruptions across commit boundaries on the target storage and verify no acknowledged event is lost.

title: Disconnected duration
requirement: The system shall support a proposed seven-day isolated campaign within an approved authority and capacity budget.
acceptance: Complete a seven-day soak without external authentication, licensing, package or time-service dependencies.

title: Offline collaboration
requirement: The system shall support authorized local operator and witness use through one station authority, with explicit connectivity status.
acceptance: Use two browsers on an isolated LAN and reject conflicting execution actions.

title: Readiness boundaries
requirement: The system shall distinguish central service failure from unavailable local storage, invalid authority or missing safety prerequisites.
acceptance: Verify central outage permits prepared work while loss of local durable storage inhibits new operations.

title: Portable transport
requirement: The system shall support encrypted, signed export/import bundles when network synchronization is unavailable.
acceptance: Import the same removable-media bundle twice and verify deduplication and custody records.

title: Offline capability manifest
requirement: The system shall declare offline support and preparation prerequisites for every enabled action and adapter and reject package readiness when required operations are unavailable.
acceptance: Prepare a run requiring start, QA signoff, redline, camera capture, Python/VISA, analysis and upload; disconnect and verify each declared capability or a pre-departure blocker.
basis: Derived refinement: procedure cache eligibility does not prove the entire workflow can operate offline.

title: Transactional outbox
requirement: The system shall atomically store each accepted event and its replication obligation in the local transaction.
acceptance: Crash after commit and before upload; verify the event remains queued after restart.

title: Idempotent ingest
requirement: The system shall deduplicate retransmissions by stable identity and reject identical IDs with different content.
acceptance: Retry a batch after losing its acknowledgment and verify exactly one central record per event.

title: Resumable transfer
requirement: The system shall resume verified artifact chunks without marking incomplete evidence as complete.
acceptance: Disconnect repeatedly during a 10 GB upload and verify the final digest and missing-chunk accounting.

title: Completeness receipt
requirement: The system shall issue reconciliation receipts only after required sequences, signatures and artifacts validate.
acceptance: Upload all metadata but omit one attachment and verify closure remains blocked.

title: Conflict quarantine
requirement: The system shall preserve conflicting signed records and require explicit resolution instead of last-writer-wins.
acceptance: Submit two incompatible offline branches and verify both survive with a blocked disputed transition.

title: Ownership fencing
requirement: The system shall reject stale ownership epochs and prevent resynchronization from authorizing a second hardware commander.
acceptance: Reconnect an old station after handoff and verify it cannot resume instrument control.

title: Reference reconciliation
requirement: The system shall compare execution snapshots with later releases, recalls and revocations and generate review tasks.
acceptance: Reconnect after a calibration recall and verify affected runs are flagged without history edits.

title: Retention acknowledgment
requirement: The system shall retain local evidence until complete central receipt and configured backup/retention gates are met.
acceptance: Lose the final receipt or fail the central backup gate and verify local cleanup is refused.

title: Per-operation reconciliation visibility
requirement: The system shall display locally committed, upload pending, uploaded, centrally verified and conflicted states for required events and artifacts without collapsing them into one synced flag.
acceptance: Upload event metadata while withholding an attachment and a signature dependency; verify operators can identify both blockers and final closure remains inhibited.
basis: Derived refinement: optimistic online status must not be mistaken for verified completeness.

title: Execution checklist
requirement: The system shall require step dispositions, required signatures, evidence completeness and final article configuration for execution review.
acceptance: Leave each item unresolved in turn and verify the review gate explains the blocker.

title: Separate analysis
requirement: The system shall track analysis tasks, owners, inputs and approvals independently from execution completion.
acceptance: Complete a run with analysis pending and verify it is not labeled fully closed.

title: Reproducible analysis
requirement: The system shall record analysis code, dependencies, parameters, input hashes and output revisions.
acceptance: Re-run the approved analysis on retained inputs and compare outputs under stated tolerances.

title: Approval invalidation
requirement: The system shall invalidate applicability of analysis approval when its inputs, code or acceptance rules change.
acceptance: Revise a reduction script and verify a new analysis approval is required.

title: Closure gate
requirement: The system shall permit final closure only after reconciliation, required approvals and authorized deviation dispositions.
acceptance: Attempt closure with one missing approver, unresolved conflict or incomplete upload and confirm denial.

title: Requirement disposition
requirement: The system shall report verified, failed, waived, invalid and not-yet-verified requirements with evidence links.
acceptance: Verify a waived failure remains distinct from a measured pass in the verification matrix.

title: Amendment lifecycle
requirement: The system shall reopen closed records through controlled amendments while preserving the prior closure manifest.
acceptance: Correct an archived analysis and reconstruct both the original and amended acceptance states.

title: Work queues
requirement: The system shall provide ownership, due dates, escalation and observer access for execution and analysis action items.
acceptance: Assign overdue tasks and verify notifications do not silently approve or close them.

title: Enforced access
requirement: The system shall enforce role, project and article scope at the API and data-access layers.
acceptance: Attempt cross-project reads and unauthorized mutations directly through APIs and verify denial.

title: Local attack surface
requirement: The system shall authenticate local clients and protect against cross-origin requests, host spoofing and unauthorized LAN access.
acceptance: Attempt browser-based requests from an untrusted origin and verify commands cannot be issued.

title: Protected secrets
requirement: The system shall encrypt sensitive records at rest and in transit, and protect keys and credentials with approved storage and rotation.
acceptance: Rotate keys without losing historical evidence; verify encrypted storage and transport and absence of secrets in exports.

title: Approved software
requirement: The system shall verify signed software packages and prohibit unapproved upgrades during active runs.
acceptance: Offer a new release during a run and verify it cannot change the pinned execution environment.

title: Privileged activity
requirement: The system shall record administrator actions and restrict modification or deletion of authoritative evidence.
acceptance: Attempt an administrative edit and verify prevention or a detectable controlled amendment.

title: Worker containment
requirement: The system shall apply least-privilege filesystem, network and device access to test workers.
acceptance: Use a test worker to attempt unauthorized file, network and device access and verify rejection.

title: Assurance record
requirement: The system shall maintain requirements-to-test traceability, dependency inventory, known limitations and reviewed release evidence.
acceptance: Audit a candidate release and resolve every P0 requirement to recorded acceptance evidence.

title: Environment separation
requirement: The system shall distinguish simulation, development, engineering and flight operation in access rules and stored records.
acceptance: Attempt to present simulated measurements as flight evidence and verify the provenance is unmistakable.

title: Optimistic mutation control
requirement: The system shall require expected revision preconditions for consequential API mutations and return conflicts without overwriting newer accepted state.
acceptance: Submit two concurrent limit or redline edits against the same revision; verify only one succeeds and the other must be reviewed against the new state.
basis: TestForge design choice: prevent silent last-writer-wins behavior in consequential edits.

title: Service principal boundaries
requirement: The system shall identify service actions separately from human signatures and scope integration credentials by project and permitted action, with recorded rotation and revocation.
acceptance: Use a valid ingestion credential to attempt QA approval or cross-project reads; verify denial and attributable audit events.
basis: Derived refinement: access to automation APIs is not authority to impersonate a witness.

title: Debug action provenance
requirement: The system shall restrict forced outcomes, execution-pointer changes and variable edits to authorized engineering operation and label resulting evidence so it cannot satisfy flight acceptance silently.
acceptance: Force a pass and alter a variable during debugging; verify attributable events and rejection of the modified run as unqualified flight acceptance evidence.
basis: Derived control for powerful test-executive debugging facilities; engineering overrides are not measured passes.

title: Operational display
requirement: The system shall show article identity, revision, active step, ownership, hardware status, local persistence and sync backlog.
acceptance: An operator identifies the authoritative run and unsynchronized evidence without navigating away.

title: Clear actions
requirement: The system shall distinguish hold, resume, abort, skip, repeat and emergency safing with appropriate role and confirmation rules.
acceptance: Run a witnessed usability exercise and verify no ambiguous button initiates a repeat or closes a failed step.

title: Accessible interaction
requirement: The system shall support keyboard operation, readable contrast, non-color status cues and documented supported browsers.
acceptance: Complete a procedure without a mouse and verify errors remain identifiable without color.

title: Reference load
requirement: The system shall meet proposed targets of 10,000 steps per procedure and 100 structured events per second per station.
acceptance: Run the reference load with a proposed p95 local action acknowledgment below 500 ms, excluding instrument latency.

title: Startup and recovery
requirement: The system shall restore the UI and a truthful recovered run state within a proposed 60 seconds on approved hardware.
acceptance: Restart a loaded station; verify readiness timing without automatically resuming hardware actions.

title: Observability
requirement: The system shall expose correlated health, logs and metrics without treating diagnostic telemetry as the evidence record.
acceptance: Disable telemetry export and verify execution evidence remains complete and locally inspectable.

title: Install and upgrade
requirement: The system shall support reproducible offline installation, controlled schema migration and rollback or forward-recovery procedures.
acceptance: Install on a clean isolated host and rehearse a failed upgrade without losing historical records.

title: Capacity and support
requirement: The system shall document storage sizing, backups, restore, instrument compatibility and incident recovery for operators.
acceptance: A second engineer follows the runbook to restore a station and identify an unresolved command outcome.

title: Versioned custom metadata
requirement: The system shall support typed, scoped custom metadata with schema revision and distinguish classification fields from evidence or acceptance fields.
acceptance: Change a custom field type after release; verify historical values retain their schema and consequential fields require controlled revision.
basis: Derived extensibility requirement; customization must not bypass evidence controls.

title: Handover acknowledgment
requirement: The system shall require the incoming authorized operator to acknowledge outstanding holds, unknown command outcomes, pending redlines and assigned tasks before taking control.
acceptance: Transfer a run with an unresolved command and reassigned task; verify control stays blocked until acknowledgment and hardware recovery gates are met.
basis: Derived refinement of task tracking and shift continuity.

title: Durable workflow actions
requirement: The system shall version event-triggered administrative workflows and durably track deduplicated actions, bounded retries and terminal failures without issuing hardware commands directly.
acceptance: Deliver the same failed-step event twice, interrupt issue creation and retry; verify one logical issue and a visible unresolved action if the destination remains unavailable.
basis: Derived reliability requirement for trigger/condition/action automation.

title: Dependency closure verification
requirement: The system shall require explicit declaration and offline availability checks for dynamically loaded code, data, drivers and configuration in addition to statically discovered dependencies.
acceptance: Install on a clean isolated station after removing a dynamically selected calibration file or native library; verify readiness fails before commanding hardware.
basis: Derived deployment refinement: static dependency discovery cannot find every runtime-selected resource.

title: Platform capability qualification
requirement: The system shall publish and enforce a versioned capability matrix for each supported OS, runtime, adapter, driver and deployment mode, rejecting unsupported required features before installation or run admission.
acceptance: Offer a package requiring an unavailable result sink or driver on one target platform; verify explicit rejection rather than silently disabled evidence processing.
basis: Derived requirement prompted by platform-specific deployment differences; no cross-platform parity is presumed.

title: Correlated execution diagnostics
requirement: The system shall expose run, thread, worker and nested-call context with step identities and correlated diagnostic events while keeping diagnostics distinct from authoritative evidence.
acceptance: Interleave two nested parallel runs and a worker failure; reconstruct the affected call path without assigning another run's logs or results to it.
basis: Derived debuggability requirement for layered and concurrent execution.
